en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Botswana
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, sends a message of felicitations to Honourable Phenyo Butale, Minister of International Relations of the Republic of Botswana, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Botswana.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, sends a message of felicitations to Honourable Phenyo Butale, Minister of International Relations of the Republic of Botswana, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Botswana.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, and on my own behalf, I wish to extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the Republic of Botswana on the occasion of your Independence Day.

I also take this opportunity to extend my best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health and well-being, and for further peace and prosperity for the people of Botswana.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration”

ENDS

dv.title: ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް ތަހުނިޔާ ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އޮނަރަބަލް ޕެންޔޯ ބޫޓޭލޭއަށް، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ހަރ އެކްސެލެންސީ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވަފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އޮނަރަބަލް  ޕެންޔޯ ބޫޓޭލޭއަށް، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ހަރ އެކްސެލެންސީ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވަފިއެވެ.

ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

"ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ‎ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ ސަރުކާރަށާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް އަރިސްކުރަމެވެ.

މަނިކުފާނަށް ދުޅަހެޔޮ ސިއްހަތާއި ބޮޓްސްވާނާގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް އިތުރު ސުލްހަ އާއި ތަނަވަސްކަން ލިބުމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު އެދެމެވެ.

އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުޞަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam extends condolences to the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of Thailand following floods
en.description: Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives has sent a message of condolence to His Excellency Sihasak Phuangketkeow, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Thailand, following the severe floods caused by heavy rainfall.
en.body:
Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives has sent a message of condolence to His Excellency Sihasak Phuangketkeow, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Thailand, following  the severe floods caused by heavy rainfall.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is with deep sadness that I received the news of the devastating floods caused by heavy monsoon rains in Thailand, which have resulted in the tragic loss of lives, extensive damage to property and infrastructure, and severe displacement of many communities.

On behalf of the Government and the people of the Republic of Maldives, and on my own behalf, I extend our heartfelt condolences and deepest sympathies to Your Excellency, the Government, and the friendly people of the Kingdom of Thailand, especially to the bereaved families. We also convey our sincere wishes for the speedy recovery of those injured and affected.

I commend the resilience of the Thai people and the tireless efforts of the emergency services and rescue teams. It is our earnest hope that relief and recovery operations proceed smoothly to bring swift assistance and comfort to those in need.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration. ”

ENDS

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham concludes official visit to New York to participate in the High-level Week of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Iruthisham Adam, today, concluded her official visit to New York to participate in the High-level Week of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) being held at UN Headquarters from 22-28 September 2026. The delegation to the eighty-first…
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Iruthisham Adam, today, concluded her official visit to New York to participate in the High-level Week of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) being held at UN Headquarters from 22-28 September 2026. The delegation to the eighty-first session was  led by Vice President His Excellency Uz Mohamed Hussain Latheef.

Throughout the visit, Minister Iruthisham carried forward the message delivered by Vice President Hussain Mohamed Latheef in his address to the General Debate on 25 September 2026, advancing the Maldives priorities across high-level meetings and events during the High-Level Week.

At the General Assembly’s High-Level Meetings on the Right to Development and Pandemic Prevention and Preparedness, Minister Iruthisham called for an international environment that enables every State to have the freedom and capacity to shape its own future.

Minister Iruthisham highlighted the importance of technology transfer, resilient supply chains, accessible financing, and an inclusive digital future, while calling for UN reform focused on delivery, a more representative Security Council, fairer global financial systems, stronger action on peace and security, and greater women’s leadership. She also advanced the priorities of Small Island Developing States (SIDS) and reaffirmed the Maldives commitment to the rights of the Palestinian people, including through the Annual Coordination Meetings of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) and the Group of 77 and China. Throughout the High-Level Week, she engaged with counterparts to strengthen cooperation on shared priorities and promote partnerships based on mutual interests.

Minister of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development Dr Ismail Shafeeu led Maldives engagement across the side events held by Global Partnership for Education reaffirming Maldives commitment to promoting quality education.

The High-Level Week of the 81st session of the UNGA brought together world leaders and representatives to address the Assembly under this year’s theme, “Restoring Trust, Managing Transformation: A United Nations That Delivers for All.”

ENDS

dv.title: އދ. ގެ އާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައި-ލެވެލް ހަފުތާގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތުމަށް، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އިރުތިޝާމް ނިއުޔޯކަށް ކުރެއްވި ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅު ނިންމަވާލައްވައިފި
dv.description: އދ.ގެ ޢާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައި-ލެވެލް ހަފްތާ ގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތުމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ނިއުޔޯކަށް ކުރެއްވި ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅު މިއަދު ނިންމަވާލައްވައިފިއެވެ. ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދުގައި އިސްކޮށް ހުންނެވީ ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާގެ ނައިބު އަލްއުސްތާޛު…
dv.body:
އދ.ގެ ޢާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައި-ލެވެލް ހަފްތާ ގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތުމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ނިއުޔޯކަށް ކުރެއްވި ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅު މިއަދު ނިންމަވާލައްވައިފިއެވެ.  ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދުގައި އިސްކޮށް ހުންނެވީ ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާގެ ނައިބު އަލްއުސްތާޛު މުޙައްމަދު ޙުސައިން ލަޠީފް އެވެ. މި ސެޕްޓެމްބަރު މަހުގެ 22 އިން 28 އަށް އދ.ގެ މައި މަރުކަޒުގައި ކުރިއަށްދިޔަ މި ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގައި، ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާގެ ނައިބު 25 ވަނަ ދުވަހު އދ.ގެ ޢާންމު ބަހުސްގައި ދެއްވި ތަޤުރީރުގެ މެސެޖުތައް ކުރިއަށް ނެރުއްވައި، ރާއްޖެއިން އިސްކަންދޭ މުހިންމު ކަންކަމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން މިނިސްޓަރ އިރުތިޝާމް ވަނީ އެކި ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގައި ވަކާލާތު ކުރައްވާފައެވެ.

މީގެއިތުރުން، ތަރައްޤީވުމުގެ ޙައްޤާ ބެހޭގޮތުންނާއި، ބަލިމަޑުކަމުން ރައްކާތެރިވުމާއި އެކަމަށް ތައްޔާރުވެފައި އޮތުމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން ބޭއްވި ހައި-ލެވެލް ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގައި، ކޮންމެ ޤައުމަކަށްވެސް އެ ޤައުމެއްގެ މުސްތަޤުބަލު އަމިއްލައަށް ބިނާކުރުމުގެ މިނިވަންކަމާއި ފުރުޞަތު ފަހިވެފައިވާ ބައިނަލްއަޤުވާމީ މާޙައުލެއް ޤާއިމުކުރުމުގެ މުހިންމުކަމުގެ މައްޗަށް މިނިސްޓަރ އަލިއަޅުއްވާލެއްވިއެވެ.

މިނިސްޓަރ އިރުތިޝާމް ވަނީ ޓެކްނޮލޮޖީ ޓްރާންސްފާއާއި، ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި ސަޕްލައި ޗެއިންތަކާއި، ފަސޭހައިން ލިބޭނޭ މާލީ އެހީތެރިކަމާއި، އެންމެން ހިމެނޭހެން ބިނާކުރެވޭ ޑިޖިޓަލް މުސްތަޤުބަލެއްގެ މުހިންމުކަން ފާހަގަކުރައްވާފައެވެ. މިގޮތުން، އދ. ގެ ނިޒާމަށް ގެންނަންޖެހޭ ބަދަލުތަކުގެ ތެރޭގައި، ނަތީޖާ ނެރެވޭނެ މަސައްކަތްތަކަށް އިސްކަންދިނުމާއި، ސަލާމަތީ މަޖިލީހަކީ ހުރިހާ ޤައުމެއްގެ ތަމްސީލުވުން އެކުލެވޭ ތަނަކަށް ހެދުމާއި، ދުނިޔޭގެ މާލީ ނިޒާމުތައް މިހާރަށްވުރެ އިންސާފުވެރި ކުރުމަށް އެކަމަނާ ގޮވާލެއްވިއެވެ. މީގެ އިތުރުން، ސުލްހަޔާއި ސަލާމަތަށްޓަކައި ވަރުގަދަ ފިޔަވަޅުތަކެއް އެޅުމަށާއި، އަންހެނުންގެ ލީޑަރޝިޕް އިތުރުކުރުމަށް ބާރުއެޅުއްވިއެވެ. އޯގަނައިޒޭޝަން އޮފް އިސްލާމިކް ކޯޕަރޭޝަން (އޯ.އައި.ސީ) އަދި ޖީ-77 އާއި ޗައިނާގެ އަހަރީ ކޯޑިނޭޝަން ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގައި، ތަރައްޤީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ޤައުމުތަކުގެ (ސިޑްސް) އިސްކަންދޭ ކަންކަން ކުރިއެރުވުމަށާއި، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ރައްޔިތުންގެ ޙައްޤުތައް ހިމާޔަތްކުރުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން ދެމިއޮންނާނެކަން އެކަމަނާ އަލުން ކަށަވަރުކޮށްދެއްވިއެވެ. ހައި ލެވެލް ހަފްތާގެ ތެރޭގައި، އެކި ޤައުމުތަކުގެ މަންދޫބުންނާ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައި، އެކުވެރިކަމާއި ގުޅިގެން މަސައްކަތްކުރުމުގެ މަޤްސަދުގައި ދެފަރާތުން އިސްކަންދޭ ކަންކަމުގައި އެއްބާރުލުން އިތުރުކުރުމަށް މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެޑިޔުކޭޝަން، ހަޔަރ އެޑިޔުކޭޝަން އެންޑް ސްކިލްސް ޑިވެލޮޕްމަންޓް ޑރ. އިސްމާޢީލް ޝަފީޢު ވަނީ ގްލޯބަލް ޕާޓްނަރޝިޕް ފޯ އެޑިޔުކޭޝަންގެ ފަރާތުން އދ.ގެ ޢާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހަވާސާގައި ބޭއްވި ހަރަކާތްތަކުގައި ރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެންފައެވެ. މި ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގައި، ފެންވަރު ރަނގަޅު ތަޢުލީމު ކުރިއެރުވުމަށް ރާއްޖެއިން ކުރަމުންދާ މަސައްކަތްތަކާއި، އެކަމުގައި ދެމިއޮންނާނެކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން މިނިސްޓަރ ދެއްވިއެވެ.

އދ. ގެ އާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ދައުރުގެ ހައިލެވެލް ބައްދަލުވުންތަކުގެ ހަފުތާގައި، ދުނިޔޭގެ ލީޑަރުންނާއި މަންދޫބުން ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެން، "ރިސްޓޯރިންގް ޓްރަސްޓް، މެނޭޖިންގް ޓްރާންސްފޯމޭޝަން: އަ ޔުނައިޓެޑް ނޭޝަންސް ދެޓް ޑެލިވާސް ފޯ އޯލް"، މި ޝިއާރުގެ ދަށުން މަޖިލީހުގައި ތަގުރީރުކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam sends National Day greetings to the Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan
en.description: On the occasion of the Independence Day of Turkmenistan, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, conveyed her warm greetings and good wishes to His Excellency Rashid Meredov, Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and the Minister of Foreign…
en.body:
On the occasion of the Independence Day of Turkmenistan, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, conveyed her warm greetings and good wishes to His Excellency Rashid Meredov, Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“My warmest felicitations and sincere, good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of the Republic of Turkmenistan on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

We attach great importance to the friendly relations with Turkmenistan, and I have no doubt that the cooperation between our two countries will be further strengthened in the years ahead.

I look forward to working closely with Your Excellency in strengthening the existing ties of friendship and further elevating the relationship for the mutual benefit of our peoples.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and well-being, and for the continued peace, progress and prosperity of the people of the Republic of Turkmenistan, along with the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެ ޤައުމުގެ ޑެޕިއުޓީ ޗެއާރމަން އޮފް ދަ ކެބިނެޓް އޮފް މިނިސްޓަރސް އަދި ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، އެ ޤައުމުގެ ޑެޕިއުޓީ ޗެއާރމަން އޮފް ދަ ކެބިނެޓް އޮފް މިނިސްޓަރސް އަދި ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ހިޒް އެކްސަލަންސީ ރާޝިދު މެރެދޯފް އަށް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، އެ ޤައުމުގެ ޑެޕިއުޓީ ޗެއާރމަން އޮފް ދަ ކެބިނެޓް އޮފް މިނިސްޓަރސް އަދި ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ހިޒް އެކްސަލަންސީ ރާޝިދު މެރެދޯފް އަށް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި އެވަނީއެވެ.

" ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ އުފާވެރި މުނާސަބަތުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި، ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ ސަރުކާރާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި ތަހުނިޔާ އަރިސް ކުރުމަކީ އަޅުގަނޑަށް ލިބޭ ނުހަނު ބޮޑު އުފަލެކެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން އާ ދެމެދު އޮންނަ ޒަމާންވީ ގާތް ގުޅުމުގެ އަގު ރާއްޖެއިން ވަޒަން ކުރަމެވެ. ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރު ތަކުގައި، ދެ ޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދު އޮންނަ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާ ވެގެންދާނޭކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން އަޅުގަނޑަށް އެބައޮތެވެ.

ދެ ޤައުމުގެ މަސްލަހަތާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ފައިދާ ހުރި ކަންކަމުގައި އާއި މިގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހި ކުރުމަށް ގުޅިގެން މަސައްކަތް ކުރުމަށް ތައްޔާރަށް ހުރީމެވެ.
މި ފުރުޞަތުގައި، މަނިކުފާނަށް ދުޅަހެޔޮ ޞިއްޙަތާއި ކާމިޔާބީއަށް އެދި، އަދި ތުރުކްމެނިސްތާން ގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް އަމާންކަމާއި، ކުރިއެރުމާއި އުފާ ފާގަތިކަމަށް އެދެމެވެ.

އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އަރުވަމެވެ.

en.title: Maldives and Angola sign two MoUs to advance bilateral relations
en.description: The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Angola today signed two Memorandum of Understanding on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.
en.body:
The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Angola today signed two Memorandum of Understanding on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

The MoUs were signed on behalf of the Government of the Maldives by Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs, and on behalf of the Government of Angola by His Excellency Téte António, Minister of External Relations.

The MoU on Political Consultations establishes a formal mechanism for the two Ministries to hold regular discussions on bilateral relations, exchange views on regional and international developments, and identify new areas of cooperation.

The MoU between the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives (FOSIM) and Angola’s Venâncio de Moura Diplomatic Academy will facilitate collaboration between the two institutions in professional training, diplomatic skills development and the sharing of experience and best practices.

The agreements build on the discussions held during the Ministers meeting in Malé in June 2026 and mark a further step in strengthening bilateral relations between the Maldives and Angola.

The Maldives and Angola established diplomatic relations on 10 November 2020.

ENDS

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham urges sustainable financing for resilient health systems for SIDS at the UN High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Preparedness
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs Iruthisham Adam, delivered remarks at the High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response (PPPR), held during the 81st session High-level Week of the United Nations General Assembly. The meeting convened under the overarching theme of fostering a…
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs Iruthisham Adam, delivered remarks at the High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response (PPPR), held during the 81st session High-level Week of the United Nations General Assembly. The meeting convened under the overarching theme of fostering a multilateral and intergenerational approach to prevent, prepare for, and respond to pandemics and public health emergencies through the principles of equity and solidarity.

Minister Iruthisham Adam highlighted the acute vulnerabilities of Small Island Developing States (SIDS), recalling that the COVID-19 pandemic wiped out over one-third of the Maldives economic output in 2020, erasing 15 years of development progress. She stressed that SIDS require sustainable and pre-emptive financing, resilient supply chains for vaccines, diagnostics and medicines, and continued investment in health workforces, technology transfer, surveillance and laboratory networks.

Minister Iruthisham Adam reaffirmed the Maldives commitment to multilateral frameworks, including the WHO Pandemic Agreement and the International Health Regulations (2005), emphasising that future preparedness must ensure that financing is available, systems are interconnected, essential supplies are accessible, and communities are equipped to respond. She noted that such preparedness is critical not only to protecting lives, but also to safeguarding development gains and preserving countries’ ability to determine their own future.

The second High-Level meeting on PPRR, pursuant to General Assembly resolution 79/333, brings together global leaders to review the implementation of the 2023 Political Declaration on PPPR. The discussions focus on assessing global progress, addressing persistent gaps, and renewing high-level political commitment to build resilient health systems worldwide.

ENDS

dv.title: ޕެންޑެމިކް ޕްރިޕެއާޑްނަސްއާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން އ.ދ. އިން ބޭއްވި ބައްދަލުމުގައި ވިލުންތެރި ސިއްހީ ނިޒާމަކަށް ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި މާލީ އެހީތެރިކަން ކަށަވަރުކުރުމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް އަލްފާޟިލް އިރުތިޝާމް އިލްތިމާސްކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: ދުނިޔޭގެ ފެންވަރުގައި އެކި ޖީލުތަކުގެ ބައިވެރިވުމާއެކު، ބަލިމަޑުކަމާއި ޞިއްޙީ ކުއްލި ނުރައްކާތަކުން ރައްކާތެރިވުމަށާއި، އެފަދަ ޙާލަތްތަކަށް ތައްޔާރުވުމުގެ އިތުރުން އިޖާބަދިނުމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން ބޭއްވި އދ. އާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައި-ލެވަލް ހަފްތާގެ ހަވާސާގައި ބޭއްވި ޔޫ.އެން. ހައި-ލެވަލް…
dv.body:
ދުނިޔޭގެ ފެންވަރުގައި އެކި ޖީލުތަކުގެ ބައިވެރިވުމާއެކު، ބަލިމަޑުކަމާއި ޞިއްޙީ ކުއްލި ނުރައްކާތަކުން ރައްކާތެރިވުމަށާއި، އެފަދަ ޙާލަތްތަކަށް ތައްޔާރުވުމުގެ އިތުރުން އިޖާބަދިނުމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން ބޭއްވި އދ. އާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައި-ލެވަލް ހަފްތާގެ ހަވާސާގައި ބޭއްވި ޔޫ.އެން. ހައި-ލެވަލް މީޓިންގ އޮން ޕެންޑަމިކް ޕްރިވެންޝަން، ޕްރިޕެއާޑްނަސް އެންޑް ރެސްޕޯންސް ގައި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް އަލްފާޟިލް އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް  ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަންނަވައިފިއެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި މިނިސްޓަރު އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަރައްގީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ގައުމުތަކަށް ކުރިމަތިވާ ގޮންޖެހުންތަކުގެ މައްޗަށް އަލިއަޅުއްވާލެއްވިއެވެ. އެގޮތުން، ކޮވިޑް-19 ގެ ބަލިމަޑުކަމުގެ ސަބަބުން 2020 ވަނަ އަހަރު ރާއްޖޭގެ އިގްތިސާދީ އުފެއްދުންތެރިކަމުގެ ތިންބައިކުޅަ އެއްބައި ގެއްލި، ވޭތުވެދިޔަ 15 އަހަރުގެ ތަރައްގީގެ ކުރިއެރުންތައް ފަހަތަށް ދިޔަކަން ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ސިޑްސް ގައުމުތަކަށް ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި މާލީ އެހީތެރިކަމާއި، ވެކްސިނާއި ބޭހާއި ބަލި ދެނެގަންނަ ވަސީލަތްތައް ފޯރުކޮށްދެވޭނެ ވަރުގަދަ ނިޒާމުތަކެއް ބޭނުންވާކަންވެސް ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ. މީގެ އިތުރުން، ސިއްހީ ދާއިރާގެ އިންސާނީ ވަސީލަތްތަކާއި، ޓެކްނޮލޮޖީ ބަދަލުކުރުމާއި، އަދި ބަލިތައް މޮނިޓަރކުރާ ލެބޯޓްރީ ނެޓްވޯކްތަކަށް އިންވެސްޓްކުރުމުގެ މުހިންމުކަން އެކަމަނާ ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ވާހަކަފުޅު ދައްކަވަމުން މިނިސްޓަރު ވަނީ، ދުނިޔޭގެ ޞިއްޙަތު ޖަމްޢިއްޔާ (ޑަބްލިއު.އެޗް.އޯ) ގެ "ޕެންޑެމިކް އެގްރީމަންޓް" އަދި "އިންޓަރނޭޝަނަލް ހެލްތު ރެގިއުލޭޝަންސް (2005)" ގެ މުހިންމުކަން ފާހަގަކުރައްވާފައެވެ. އަދި ކުރިމަގުގައި އަތުވެދާނެ ބަލިމަޑުކަމަކަށް ތައްޔާރުވުމަށްޓަކައި މާލީ ވަސީލަތްތައް ކަށަވަރުވެފައި އޮތުމާއި، ނިޒާމުތައް އެކަތިގަނޑަކަށް ގުޅިލާމެހިފައިވުމާއި، ބޭނުންވާ ތަކެއްޗާއި ވަސީލަތްތައް ހަމަހަމަކަމާއެކު ލިބޭނެ މަގު ފަހިވެފައި އޮތުމުގެ އިތުރުން މުޖުތަމަޢުގެ ފުރިހަމަ ތައްޔާރީ ޙާލަތު އޮތުމަކީ އިންސާނީ ފުރާނަ ސަލާމަތްކުރުމަށް ކޮންމެހެން މުހިންމު ކަންކަން ކަމުގައި އެކަމަނާ ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މިއީ އ.ދ.ގެ އާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ ގަރާރު ނަންބަރު 79/333 ގެ ދަށުން ބާއްވަމުންދާ ބައްދަލުވުމެކެވެ. މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގެ މައިގަނޑު ބޭނުމަކީ ބަލިމަޑުކަމުން ރައްކާތެރިވުމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން 2023 ވަނަ އަހަރު ފާސްކުރި "ޕޮލިޓިކަލް ޑެކްލެރޭޝަން އޮން ޕެންޑެމިކް ޕްރިވެންޝަން ޕްރިޕެއާޑްނެސް އެންޑް ރެސްޕޮންސް" ތަންފީޛުކުރެވެމުންދާ މިންވަރު މުރާޖަޢާކުރުމެވެ. މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގެ މަޝްވަރާތައް ބިނާވެފައިވަނީ ދުނިޔޭގެ ފެންވަރުގައި މިދާއިރާއިން ލިބިފައިވާ ކުރިއެރުންތައް ދެނެގަތުމަށާއި، ދިމާވާ ގޮންޖެހުންތަކަށް ހައްލު ހޯދުމަށާއި، އަދި ދުނިޔޭގެ އެކި ކަންކޮޅުތަކުގައި ބަލިތަކަށް އިޖާބަދެވޭފަދަ ވަރުގަދަ ސިއްހީ ނިޒާމުތަކެއް ބިނާކުރުމުގެ މައްޗަށެވެ. އަދި މި އަހަރު ބޭއްވި ބައްދަލުވުމަކީ ޕެންޑެމިކް ޕްރިވެންޝަން ޕްރިޕެއާޑްނެސް އެންޑް ރެސްޕޮންސް ގެ ދެވަނަ ހައި-ލެވެލް ބައްދަލުވުމެވެ.

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: The Maldives and Croatia sign MoU on Political Consultations
en.description: The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Croatia have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Political Consultations. The MoU was signed on the sidelines of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.
en.body:
The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Croatia have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Political Consultations. The MoU was signed on the sidelines of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives signed on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Maldives and His Excellency Gordan Grlić-Radman, Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia signed on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Croatia. The signing took place following a meeting between the two Ministers.

The MoU aims to enhance and expand bilateral cooperation between the Maldives and Croatia through facilitation of regular political consultations on areas of mutual importance. The signing also demonstrates the shared commitment to strengthen the existing ties of friendship between the two countries.

ENDS.

dv.title: ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ކްރޮއޭޝިއާ އާ ދެމެދު ޕޮލިޓިކަލް ކޮންސަލްޓޭޝާންސް ފަހުމުނާމާ އެއްގައި ސޮއި ކޮށްފި
dv.description: "އެކުވެރި ދައުލަތްތަކުގެ ޢާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައިލެވެލް ހަފުތާގެ ހަވާސާގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ކްރޮއޭޝިއާ އާ ދެމެދު "މެމޮރެންޑަމް އޮފް އަންޑަސްޓޭންޑިންގ (އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ.) އޮން ޕޮލިޓިކަލް ކޮންސަލްޓޭޝަންސް" ގައި، ނިއުޔޯކްގައި މިއަދު ސޮއިކޮށްފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
"އެކުވެރި ދައުލަތްތަކުގެ ޢާންމު މަޖިލީހުގެ 81 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގެ ހައިލެވެލް ހަފުތާގެ ހަވާސާގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ކްރޮއޭޝިއާ އާ ދެމެދު  "މެމޮރެންޑަމް އޮފް އަންޑަސްޓޭންޑިންގ (އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ.) އޮން ޕޮލިޓިކަލް ކޮންސަލްޓޭޝަންސް" ގައި، ނިއުޔޯކްގައި މިއަދު ސޮއިކޮށްފިއެވެ.

ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުގެ ފަރާތުން މި ފަހުމުނާމާގައި ސޮއި ކުރެއްވީ، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް އެވެ. އަދި  ކްރޮއޭޝިއާގެ ފަރާތުން ސޮއިކުރެއްވީ، އެ ޤައުމުގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެން ޔޫރަޕިއަން އެފެއާޒް އެފެއާޒް، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ގަރލިޗް ރަޑްމެން އެވެ. އަދި މި ފަހުމުނާމާގައި ސޮއި ކުރެވިފައި ވަނީ ދެ ވަޒީރުންގެ ދެމެދުގައި ބޭއްވުނު ބައްދަލުވުމަކަށްފަހުއެވެ.

މި ފަހުމުނާމާގައި ސޮއިކުރެވުމާއެކު، ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ކްރޮއޭޝިއާއާ ދެމެދު އޮތް ޚާރިޖީ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިވެގެންދާނެއެވެ. އަދި ދެ ޤައުމަށް ލާބަޔާއި މަންފާހުރި ދާއިރާތަކުން ގުޅުން ބަދަހިކުރުމަށްޓަކައި، ގަވާއިދުން މަޝްވަރާ ބައްދަލުވުންތައް ބޭއްވުމަށް މަގުފަހިވެގެންދާނެއެވެ. މީގެއިތުރުން، މި އެއްބަސްވުމުން ރަމްޒުކޮށްދެނީ ދެ ޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައިވާ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާކުރުމަށް ދެ ފަރާތުންވެސް ބޭނުންވާ މިންވަރާއި، އެކަމަށް ފުރިހަމައަށް ތައްޔާރުވެފައިވާ ކަމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ

en.title: Foreign Minister Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Guinea-Bissau
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Fatumata Jau, Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation & Communities, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of…
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Fatumata Jau, Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation & Communities, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Republic of Maldives, and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau, on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

I look forward to working with Your Excellency to strengthen the relations between the Republic of Maldives and the Republic of Guinea-Bissau in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS.

dv.title: ގިނީ-ބިސާއު މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ގިނީ-ބިސާއުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް ތަހުނިޔާ ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ގިނީ-ބިސާއުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، މިސްޓަރ ފާޓުމަޓާ ޖާއު އަށް، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވަފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ގިނީ-ބިސާއުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، މިސްޓަރ ފާޓުމަޓާ ޖާއު އަށް، ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވަފިއެވެ.

ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

"ގިނީ-ބިސާއުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ‎ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި ކަމަނާއަށާއި ގިނީ-ބިސާއުގެ ސަރުކާރަށާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް އަރިސްކުރަމެވެ.

ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އަޅުގަނޑުމެންގެ ދެ ޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައި އޮތް ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިކުރުމަށްޓަކައި ކަމަނާއާއެކު ގާތުން މަސައްކަތް ކުރުމަށް އުންމީދުކުރަމެވެ.

އަޅުގަނޑު ކަމަނާއަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުޞަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ

en.title: The Maldives and Belarus sign Agreement on Mutual Exemption on Visas
en.description: The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Belarus signed the Agreement on Mutual Exemption of Visas, on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York today.
en.body:
The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Belarus signed the Agreement on Mutual Exemption of Visas, on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York today.

The Agreement was signed on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Maldives by Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, and on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Belarus by His Excellency Maxim Ryzhenkov, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Belarus.

The Agreement provides for mutual exemption of visas for nationals of both countries and permits single-entry stays of up to 30 days, or multiple-entry stays for a cumulative period not exceeding 90 days, within one calendar year.

During the discussions following the signing ceremony, Minister Iruthisham expressed her gratitude to the Government of the Republic of Belarus for its commitment towards strengthening the existing ties of friendship and cooperation between the two countries and conveyed hope that the signing of this agreement will increase avenues for further engagement and people-to-people contact between the Maldives and Belarus.

ENDS.

en.title: The Maldives and Viet Nam concluded Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Socialist Republic of Viet Nam
en.description: The Maldives and Viet Nam have concluded a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, aimed at further strengthening the longstanding bonds of friendship…
en.body:
The Maldives and Viet Nam have concluded a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, aimed at further strengthening the longstanding bonds of friendship and cooperation between the two countries.

The MoU between both Foreign Ministries will provide a structured framework for regular dialogue on bilateral, regional, and international issues of mutual interest.

The MoU was exchanged following the bilateral meeting between Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, His Excellency Dr. Le Hoai Trung, at the side lines of the High-Level Segment of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly, in New York.

Minister Iruthisham expressed confidence that the formalization of the MoU on Cooperation between the two Foreign Ministries will contribute to closer cooperation and enhanced engagement between the two countries. She also expressed her commitment to working closely with Viet Nam to advance cooperation and explore new avenues for partnership, for the benefit of the people of both countries.

ENDS

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam sends National Day Greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, His Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud on the occasion of the 96th National Day of the Kingdom.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, His Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud on the occasion of the 96th National Day of the Kingdom.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On the joyous occasion of the 96th National Day of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, I have the honour to convey my warmest congratulations to Your Highness, the Government and the brotherly people of Saudi Arabia.

The theme of this year’s National Day, ‘Our Pride Is in Our Nature’, proudly reflects the strong national identity of the Saudi people and the values that continue to guide the Kingdom’s progress.

Over the decades, the Maldives and Saudi Arabia have built a partnership grounded in mutual respect, shared faith and a common vision for the prosperity of our peoples. The Kingdom's generous support has left a lasting imprint on the Maldives' development journey, and we take this occasion to reaffirm our appreciation for a friendship that has stood the test of time. We remain committed to working closely with the Kingdom to explore new avenues of cooperation.

May I extend my best wishes and prayers for Your Highness’s good health and well-being and continued progress and prosperity of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its people.

Please accept, Your Highness, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

en.title: Maldives and Kenya Sign MoU on Political Consultations
en.description: The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Kenya have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Political Consultations, further strengthening the friendly relations between the two countries. The MoU was signed on the sidelines of the 81st Session of the…
en.body:
The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Republic of Kenya have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Political Consultations, further strengthening the friendly relations between the two countries. The MoU was signed on the sidelines of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives signed on behalf of the Government of Maldives and His Excellency Dr. Musalia Mudavadi, Prime Cabinet Secretary and Cabinet Secretary for Foreign and Diaspora Affairs of the Republic of Kenya signed on behalf of the Government of Kenya. The signing took place following a meeting between the two Ministers.

The MoU establishes a framework for regular consultations between the two Ministries and will provide an important platform to deepen dialogue, identify new areas of cooperation and further strengthen the Maldives–Kenya partnership.

The Maldives and Kenya established diplomatic relations on 23 October 1995 and have since enjoyed warm and friendly relations. The signing of this MoU reflects the shared commitment of both countries to further deepen their partnership and work together for the benefit of their peoples.

ENDS

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham sends National Day Greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of Belize
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of Belize, Hon. Francis Fonseca, on the occasion of the National Day of Belize.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of Belize, Hon. Francis Fonseca, on the occasion of the National Day of Belize.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Belize, on the occasion of your National Day.

As a fellow Small Island Developing State (SIDS), I look forward to strengthening cooperation between our two countries, particularly through enhancing our mutual efforts to address unique challenges faced by SIDS.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: ‏‎ ބެލީޒްގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ބެލީޒްގެެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލަންސީ ފްރާންސިސް ފޮންސެކާ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ބެލީޒްގެެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލަންސީ ފްރާންސިސް ފޮންސެކާ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏‎"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި، މަނިކުފާނާއި ބެލީޒްގެ ސަރުކާރަށާއި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް، ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި އިޚްލާޞްތެރި ހެޔޮ އެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

‏‎ ތަރައްޤީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ޤައުމުތަކަށް ކުރިމަތިވާ ގޮންޖެހުންތަކަށް ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި ހައްލު ހޯދުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ބެލީޒް އިން ކުރަމުންގެންދާ އަގުހުރި މަސައްކަތްތައް ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އިތުރަށް ވަރުގަދަވެގެންދާނެކަން އަޅުގަނޑަށް ޔަޤީނެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުން ކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Minister Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Armenia
en.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to His Excellency Ararat Mirzoyan, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia.
en.body:
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to His Excellency Ararat Mirzoyan, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government and people of the Republic of Maldives, and on my own behalf, it is my pleasure to convey warm greetings to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the Republic of Armenia on the occasion of your Independence Day.

I look forward to working with Your Excellency to further enhance the ties of friendship with Armenia, in the years to come.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes and the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS.

dv.title: އާރމީނިއާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ޤައުމުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ތަހުނިޔާ ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: އާރމީނިއާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެ ޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލަންސީ އަރާރަތް މިރްޒޮޔާން އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
އާރމީނިއާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެ ޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލަންސީ އަރާރަތް މިރްޒޮޔާން އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

"އާރމީނިއާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި އާރމީނިއާ ސަރުކާރާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި ތަހުނިޔާ ދެންނެވުމަކީ އަޅުގަނޑަށް ލިބޭ ނުހަނު ބޮޑު އުފަލެކެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި އާރމީނިއާ އާ ދެމެދު އޮތް އެކުވެރިކަމުގެ ގުޅުން ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިކުރުމަށް މަނިކުފާނާއި ގުޅިގެން މަސައްކަތް ކުރާނެކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން އަޅުގަނޑު އަރުވަމެވެ.

އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރުއާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް، މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Malta
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Malta, His Excellency Chris Fearne on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Malta.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Malta, His Excellency Chris Fearne on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Malta.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Republic of Maldives, and on my own behalf, I take this opportunity to convey warm felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of the Republic of Malta on the  joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

I hope to work closely with you to further strengthen the existing cooperation between the Maldives and Malta across areas of mutual interest.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: މޯލްޓާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ޤައުމު ގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ‏‎މޯލްޓާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެންޑް ޔޫރަޕިއަން އެފެއާޒް، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ކްރިސް ފަރން އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.
dv.body:
‏‎މޯލްޓާގެ  މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ  މިނިސްޓަރ  އޮފް  ފޮރިން  އެންޑް  ޔޫރަޕިއަން  އެފެއާޒް، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ  ކްރިސް ފަރން އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏‎"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި  މޯލްޓާގެ  ސަރުކާރު އަދި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް  މޯލްޓާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ އުފާވެރި މުނާސަބަތުގައި ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް އަރިސްކުރަމެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އުއްމީދަކީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި މޯލްޓާ އާ ދެމެދު އޮތް ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާ ކުރުމަށް ދެ ޤައުމަށްވެސް ފައިދާހުރި ދާއިރާތަކުން މަނިކުފާނާ ގުޅިގެން ގާތުން މަސައްކަތްކުރުމެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް، މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ

en.title: Message by the Minister of Foreign Affairs on the Sixty-First Anniversary of the Maldives joining the United Nations
en.description: Today we commemorate over six decades of the Maldives at the United Nations, beginning on 21 September 1965. That membership has since remained the cornerstone of our foreign policy. For the Maldives, the UN is a vital platform through which we, as a Small Island Developing State, consistently…
en.body:
Today we commemorate over six decades of the Maldives at the United Nations, beginning on 21 September 1965. That membership has since remained the cornerstone of our foreign policy. For the Maldives, the UN is a vital platform through which we, as a Small Island Developing State, consistently advocate for our rights and interests, and make our voice heard within the community of nations.

In our relentless pursuit of justice and rights for our people, we have consistently helped shape the global agenda for Small Island Developing States. From the Malé Declaration on Global Warming and Sea Level Rise, to our founding role in the Alliance of Small Island States (AOSIS), and through our work towards the historic recognition of the right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment, we have demonstrated our commitment to achieving our development ambitions through multilateralism. President Dr Mohamed Muizzu has called on SIDS to take the lead in shaping their own development and to be in the driving seat, with the international community supporting rather than prescribing our path. The Antigua and Barbuda Agenda for SIDS (ABAS) provides the framework to put this vision into practice, and our task now is implementation. We must ensure SIDS have a meaningful voice in the decisions that shape our future.

Climate change remains a defining challenge for SIDS, including the Maldives, threatening our culture, livelihoods and way of life. Access to adequate, predictable and concessional climate finance remains critical for SIDS. We continue to call for finance that reaches SIDS on the ground, for the operationalisation of commitments made under the Loss and Damage Fund, and for an international financial system that gives developing countries fair, affordable and accessible finance to build resilience, including through debt sustainability and expanded access to the means of implementation. We call for the swift and full implementation of the outcomes of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development (FfD4) and the Sevilla Commitment, translating these into genuine, tangible reform rather than declarations alone.

As we mark this anniversary, we reaffirm our commitment to the founding principles of the United Nations Charter and to multilateralism, at a time when trust in the international system is under constant strain. Joining the United Nations sixty-one years ago affirmed our place as a sovereign equal among nations. This is a principle that continues to guide our Maldives First foreign policy, as we engage with the world to safeguard our sovereignty, advance the interests and aspirations of our people, and build partnerships founded on mutual respect and mutual benefit. The Maldives will continue to be a constructive and principled voice within the United Nations, advocating for a world order that upholds justice, promotes and protects human rights regardless of the size of the nation, and fosters resilience in the face of the climate emergency that defines our era.

We thank our partners, within the UN system and beyond, who have stood with the Maldives over six decades, and we look forward to continuing this partnership in pursuit of a more just, resilient, and sustainable future for all.

ENDS

en.title: The Maldives concludes participation at the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the IAEA
en.description: The Maldives has concluded its participation in the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) held in Vienna, Austria, from 14 to 18 September 2026. This marked the first General Conference in which the Maldives took part in, as a Member State,…
en.body:
The Maldives has concluded its participation in the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) held in Vienna, Austria, from 14 to 18 September 2026. This marked the first General Conference in which the Maldives took part in, as a Member State, following its accession to the Agency on 4 December 2025. The delegation was led by Ambassador and Permanent Representative of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva Dr. Salma Rasheed.

In Ambassador Dr. Salma’s statement at the General Conference on 16 September 2026, she highlighted key priorities for the Maldives engagement with the Agency, including expanding access to cancer diagnosis and treatment, exploring low-carbon energy technologies to support Maldives energy transition; and strengthen national disaster preparedness.

The Maldives delegation also participated in the discussion on expanding access to cancer care through Rays of Hope initiative, and strengthening radioactive waste management.

Ambassador Dr Salma Rasheed held bilateral meetings with Mr. Rafael Mariano Grossi, Director General of the IAEA, and the IAEA’s Regulatory Infrastructure Development Project (RIDP) team.

The Maldives engagement at the IAEA General Conference reaffirm the commitment to strengthen cooperation with IAEA, and promote partnerships that support health, clean energy, safety, and national resilience.

ENDS

dv.title: އިންޓަރނޭޝަނަލް އެޓަމިކް އެނާރޖީ އޭޖެންސީގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރަންސް 70 ވަނަ ރެގިއުލަރ ސެޝަންގައި ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދެއް ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެ
dv.description: މި އަހަރުގެ ސެޕްޓެމްބަރ މަހުގެ 14 އިން 18 އަށް އޮސްޓްރިއާގެ ވިއެނާގައި ކުރިއަށްދިޔަ އިންޓަނޭޝަނަލް އެޓޮމިކް އެނާރޖީ އޭޖެންސީ (އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.) ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގެ 70 ވަނަ ރެގިއުލަރ ސެޝަންގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދެއް ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެއެވެ. މިއީ 4 ޑިސެމްބަރު 2025 ގައި ރާއްޖެ އެ އެޖެންސީގެ ގުޅުނު…
dv.body:
މި އަހަރުގެ ސެޕްޓެމްބަރ މަހުގެ 14 އިން 18 އަށް އޮސްޓްރިއާގެ ވިއެނާގައި ކުރިއަށްދިޔަ އިންޓަނޭޝަނަލް އެޓޮމިކް އެނާރޖީ އޭޖެންސީ (އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.) ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގެ 70 ވަނަ ރެގިއުލަރ ސެޝަންގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދެއް ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެއެވެ.  މިއީ 4 ޑިސެމްބަރު 2025 ގައި ރާއްޖެ އެ އެޖެންސީގެ ގުޅުނު ފަހުން، މެންބަރު ޤައުމެއްގެ ހައިސިއްޔަތުން ބައިވެރިވި ފުރަތަމަ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސެވެ. މި ކޮންފަރަންސްގައި ބައިވެރިވި ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދުގައި އެންމެ އިސްކޮށް ހުންނެވީ ޖެނީވާގައި ހުންނަ އ.ދ.ގެ މަރުކަޒުތަކަށް، ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން ކަނޑައަޅުއްވައިފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު ޑރ. ސަލްމާ ރަޝީދެވެ.

ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގައި ވާހަކަފުޅުދައްކަވަމުން، އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޑރ ސަލްމާ ވަނީ ކެންސަރު ބަލި ދެނެގަނެ، ފަރުވާގެ ފުރުސަތުތައް ފުޅާކުރުމާއި، ސާފު ހަކަތަ ކަށަވަރުކުރުމަށް ތިމާވެއްޓާ ރައްޓެހި ތިމާވެއްޓާ ރަހްމަތްތެރި ހަކަތައިގެ ފަންނިއްޔާތު ހޯދުމަށް ހުރި ފުރުސަތުތަކާއި، އަދި ގައުމީ ފެންވަރުގައި ކާރިސާތަކަށް ތައްޔާރުވުމުގެ ގާބިލުކަން އިތުރުކުރުމަށް އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.އެކު މަސައްކަތް ކުރަން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އިން ބޭނުންވާކަން ހާމަކުރައްވާފައެވެ.

މީގެ އިތުރުން، ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދުން ވަނީ ކޮންފަރެންސްގެ ހަވާސާގައި ރޭސް އޮފް ހޯޕް އިނިޝިއެޓިވްގެ ދަށުން ސަރަހައްދީ އަދި ދުނިޔޭގެ ފެންވަރުގައި ކެންސަރުގެ ފަރުވާ ހަރުދަނާކުރުމާއި، ރޭޑިއޯއެކްޓިވް ކުނި މެނޭޖުކުރުމުގައި ރެގިއުލޭޓަރުންނާއި ތަންފީޒުކުރާ ފަރާތްތަކުގެ ދައުރު ހަރުދަނާކުރުމާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން ބޭއްވި ހަރަކާތުގައި ބައިވެރިވެފައެވެ.

އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޑރ. ސަލްމާވަނީ އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގެ ޑިރެކްޓަރ ޖެނެރަލް ރަފައެލް މަރިއާނޯ ގްރޮސީ، އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގެ ރެގިއުލޭޓަރީ އިންފްރާސްޓްރަކްޗަރ ޑިވެލޮޕްމަންޓް ޕްރޮޖެކްޓް (އާރް.އައި.ޑީ.ޕީ) ޓީމާ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވާފައެވެ.

އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގައި ރާއްޖެއިން ފުރަތަމަ ފަހަރަށް ބައިވެރިވުމަކީ އެ އެޖެންސީއާ އެކު އޮންނަ ގުޅުން ހަރުދަނާކުރުމަށް ލިބިގެންދިޔަ މުހިންމު ފުރުސަތަކަށެވެ. އަދި މިއީ ސިއްހީ ދާއިރާ، ސާފު ހަކަތަ، ރައްކާތެރިކަން، އަދި ވިލުންތެރިކަން އިތުރުކުރުމަށް ކުރެވޭ މަސައްކަތަށް ލިބުނު އިތުރު ބާރެއްވެސްމެއެވެ.

ނިމުނީ

en.title: JOINT STATEMENT – Third Maldives – UK Strategic Dialogue
en.description: Building on the successful Strategic Dialogues held in 2023 and 2025, both sides reaffirmed their commitment to advance the UK-Maldives partnership through regular, structured engagement. Discussions covered a broad range of bilateral, regional and global issues, reflecting the depth and breadth of…
en.body:
Building on the successful Strategic Dialogues held in 2023 and 2025, both sides reaffirmed their commitment to advance the UK-Maldives partnership through regular, structured engagement. Discussions covered a broad range of bilateral, regional and global issues, reflecting the depth and breadth of cooperation between the two countries.

The UK and Maldives reiterated their shared commitment to promoting security, peace, stability and resilience in the Indian Ocean region. Discussions focused on defence cooperation, maritime security, counterterrorism and protective security. The UK reaffirmed its commitment to supporting capacity-building efforts of the Maldives through technical assistance, training and practical cooperation across policing, defence and maritime security.

Both sides reviewed consular cooperation and welcomed the close collaboration between their respective authorities in supporting citizens and addressing shared consular priorities.

The UK and Maldives exchanged views on governance, criminal justice reform, judicial independence, human rights and efforts to strengthen democratic institutions. The UK reiterated its support for Maldives’ continued efforts to consolidate democratic governance, uphold human rights and strengthen the rule of law.  Both sides welcomed continued dialogue on these shared values.

The two countries reviewed progress in economic and trade cooperation since the previous Strategic Dialogue and reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening bilateral economic ties. Maldives welcomed the UK’s suspension of tariffs on tuna imports from 20 May 2026 until 31 December 2028. Both sides welcomed continued growth in trade and investment links and discussed opportunities to expand cooperation in fisheries, tourism, renewable energy and financial services.

The UK and Maldives reaffirmed the importance of education and human capital development as a key pillar of the bilateral relationship. Both sides welcomed the role of Chevening and Commonwealth Scholarships in strengthening people-to-people ties and agreed to explore opportunities to further expand cooperation in the field of education.

The two countries also welcomed the strong and growing links between their peoples. Noting that more than 200,000 visitors from the United Kingdom travelled to Maldives in 2025, both sides recognised the important contribution of tourism, cultural exchange and interpersonal connections to the bilateral relationship.

The UK and Maldives discussed ongoing cooperation on climate change, environmental protection and marine conservation. Building on collaboration under the Ocean Country Partnership Programme, both sides agreed to further cooperation on ocean governance, marine conservation and climate resilience.  Opportunities for collaboration in advance of COP31 were discussed recognising the important leadership role of the Maldives among Small Island Developing States (SIDS) and within the Alliance of Small Island States (AOSIS).

The two sides exchanged views on regional developments and multilateral cooperation, including within the United Nations and the Commonwealth. They reaffirmed their commitment to working together to address global challenges, including those affecting SIDS.

The Dialogue was co-chaired by Laure Beaufils, Director for South Asia and Afghanistan at the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, and by Dr Hala Hameed, Secretary, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, with participation from senior officials from both governments. The Dialogue concluded with a shared commitment to continue annual Strategic Dialogues and to further strengthen the longstanding partnership between the United Kingdom and Maldives.

en.title: Maldives welcomes IAEA support for SIDS at the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the IAEA
en.description: The Ambassador and Permanent Representative of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva Dr. Salma Rasheed led the Maldives delegation to the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) being held from 14 to 18 September 2026…
en.body:
The Ambassador and Permanent Representative of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva Dr. Salma Rasheed led the Maldives delegation to the 70th Regular Session of the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) being held from 14 to 18 September 2026 in Vienna, Austria.

Speaking at the General Conference, Ambassador Dr Salma noted that since acceding to IAEA in December 2025, the Maldives has moved swiftly to build a substantive partnership with the Agency, guided by its national priorities and the unique circumstances as a Small Island Developing State on the frontlines of climate change. She also welcomed fellow SIDS Timor-Leste as a new member of the Agency.

The Ambassador further highlighted the priorities of the Maldives in acquiring support for establishing and advancing cancer care through IAEA’s Rays of Hope initiative, including building capacity for the first National Cancer Hospital and strengthening radiation safety regulation. She noted that Maldives looks forward to further outlining its priorities through its forthcoming Country Programme Framework, reaffirming commitment to the peaceful, safe and secure use of nuclear science and technology.

The IAEA General Conference is the Agency's principal policy-making forum, bringing together all Member States annually to review IAEA’s work, approve its budget and programme, and set policy direction on the peaceful applications of nuclear science and technology, as well as on nuclear safety, security and safeguards. This marks the first General Conference session in which the Maldives is participating as a Member State, following its accession on 4 December 2025.

ENDS

dv.title: ތަރައްގީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ގައުމުތަކަށް އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. މެދިވެރިކޮށް ލިބެމުންދާ އެހީތެރިކަމަށް އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރަންސްގެ 70 ވަނަ ސެޝަންގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އިން މަރްހަބާ ކިޔައިފި
dv.description: މި އަހަރުގެ ސެޕްޓެމްބަރ މަހުގެ 14 އިން 18 އަށް އޮސްޓްރިއާގެ ވިއެނާގައި ކުރިއަށްދާ އިންޓަނޭޝަނަލް އެޓޮމިކް އެނާޖީ އޭޖެންސީ (އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.) ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރަންސްގެ 70 ވަނަ ރެގިއުލަރ ސެޝަންގައި ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދު ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެއެވެ. އެ ވަފްދުގައި އެންމެ އިސްކޮށް ހުންނެވީ ޖެނީވާގައި ހުންނަ އ.ދ.ގެ…
dv.body:
މި އަހަރުގެ ސެޕްޓެމްބަރ މަހުގެ 14 އިން 18 އަށް އޮސްޓްރިއާގެ ވިއެނާގައި ކުރިއަށްދާ އިންޓަނޭޝަނަލް އެޓޮމިކް އެނާޖީ އޭޖެންސީ (އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.) ގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރަންސްގެ 70 ވަނަ ރެގިއުލަރ ސެޝަންގައި ރާއްޖޭގެ ވަފްދު ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެއެވެ. އެ ވަފްދުގައި އެންމެ އިސްކޮށް ހުންނެވީ ޖެނީވާގައި ހުންނަ އ.ދ.ގެ މަރުކަޒުތަކަށް، ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން ކަނޑައަޅުއްވައިފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު ޑރ. ސަލްމާ ރަޝީދެވެ.

2025 ވަނަ އަހަރުގެ ޑިސެމްބަރ މަހު ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގެ މެންބަރަކަށް ވީ ފަހުން، އެ އެޖެންސީއާއެކު މާނަވީ ގުޅުމެއް ބިނާކުރުމަށް ހަލުވިކަމާއެކު މަސައްކަތްތައް ކުރަމުންދާކަން ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގައި ރާއްޖެއިން ދިން ތަޤުރީރުގައި އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޑރ ސަލްމާ ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި، މި މަސައްކަތްތައް ބައްޓަންކޮށްފައިވަނީ ރާއްޖެ އިން އިސްކަންދޭ ކަންކަމުގެ މައްޗަށާއި، މޫސުމީ ބަދަލުތަކުގެ ނުރައްކާ ކުރިމަތިވަމުން އަންނަ ތަރައްގީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ގައުމެއްގެ ހައިސިއްޔަތުން ކުރިމަތިވާ ޚާއްސަ ހާލަތްތަކަށް ރިއާޔަތްކޮށްގެންކަން އެ ކަމަނާ ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ. މީގެއިތުރުން، އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ.ގެ އައު މެންބަރެއްގެ ގޮތުގައި ގުޅުނު، ތަރައްގީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ގައުމެއް ކަމަށްވާ ޓިމޯ-ލެސްޓޭއަށް އެކަމަނާ މަރުހަބާ ދެންނެވިއެވެ.
އަދި، އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގެ ރޭސް އޮފް ހޯޕް އިނީޝިއޭޓިވްގެ މެދުވެރިކޮށް ކެންސަރުގެ ފަރުވާއާ ގުޅިގެން ރާއްޖެއިން ދޭ އިސްކަން ކަންތައްތައް، ވަކިން ޚާއްސަކޮށް ރާއްޖޭގެ ފުރަތަމަ ނޭޝަނަލް ކެންސަރު ހޮސްޕިޓަލަށް ބޭނުންވާނެ ގާބިލުކަން އިތުރުކުރުމާއި، ރޭޑިއޭޝަން ރައްކާތެރިކަމާބެހޭ ގަވާއިދުތައް ހަރުދަނާކުރުމަށް ޝައުގުވެރިކަން ފާޅުކުރެއްވިއެވެ. މީގެއިތުރުން، ކަންޓްރީ ޕްރޮގްރާމް ފްރޭމްވޯކް ގެ ޒަރީއާއިން ރާއްޖެއިން އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. ގައި އިސްކަންދޭ ކަންކަން އިތުރަށް ތަފްސީލުކޮށްދިނުމަށް އުންމީދުކުރާކަން ފާހަގަކުރައްވައި، ނިއުކްލިއަރ ސައިންސާއި ޓެކްނޮލޮޖީ ސުލްހަވެރި، ރައްކާތެރި އަދި އަމާންގޮތެއްގައި ބޭނުންކުރުމަށް ރާއްޖެއިން ބާރުއަޅާކަން އެކަމަނާ ތަކުރާރުކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭގެ ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސަކީ އެ އެޖެންސީގެ ސިޔާސަތުތައް ކަނޑައަޅާ މައިގަނޑު ފޯރަމެވެ. މި ފޯރަމްގައި ކޮންމެ އަހަރަކުވެސް ހުރިހާ މެންބަރު ގައުމުތަކެއް އެއްވެ، އައި.އޭ.އީ.އޭ. އިން ކުރާ މަސައްކަތްތައް މުރާޖަޢާކޮށް، އެޖެންސީގެ ބަޖެޓާއި ޕްރޮގްރާމްތައް ފާސްކުރެއެވެ. އަދި ނިއުކްލިއަރ ސައިންސާއި ޓެކްނޮލޮޖީ ސުލްހަވެރި ބޭނުންތަކަށް ބޭނުންކުރުމުގެ އިތުރުން، ނިއުކްލިއަރ ރައްކާތެރިކަމާއި، އަމާންކަމާއި، އަދި ރައްކާތެރިކަމުގެ ފިޔަވަޅުތަކާބެހޭ ސިޔާސަތުތައް ކަނޑައަޅައެވެ. މިއީ 4 ޑިސެމްބަރ 2025 ގައި ރާއްޖެއިން މި ޖަމުޢިއްޔާގެ މެންބަރަކަށް ވީ ފަހުން، ޖެނެރަލް ކޮންފަރެންސްގެ ސެޝަނެއްގައި މެންބަރު ގައުމެއްގެ ހައިސިއްޔަތުން ބައިވެރިވާ ފުރަތަމަ ފަހަރެވެ.

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham sends Independence Day Greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Papua New Guinea
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, His Excellency Justin Tkatchenko, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Papua New Guinea.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, His Excellency Justin Tkatchenko, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Papua New Guinea.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, and on my own behalf, I wish to extend warm felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Papua New Guinea on the occasion of your Independence Day.

I am confident that cooperation between the Maldives and Papua New Guinea in multilateral fora, particularly in addressing the unique challenges faced by Small Island Developing States, will continue to grow stronger in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS.

dv.title: ‏‎ޕާޕުއާ ނިއު ގިނީގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ޕާޕުއާ ނިއު ގިނީގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލެންސީ ޖަސްޓިން ކަޗެންކޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލް އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
ޕާޕުއާ ނިއު ގިނީގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލެންސީ ޖަސްޓިން ކަޗެންކޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލް އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏‎"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި، ޕާޕުއާ ނިއު ގިނީގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި އިޚްލާސްތެރި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

‏‎ތަރައްޤީވަމުން އަންނަ ކުދި ޖަޒީރާ ޤައުމުތަކަށް ކުރިމަތިވާ ގޮންޖެހުންތަކަށް ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި ހައްލު ހޯދުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާއި ޕަޕުއާ ނިއު ގިނީ އިން ކުރަމުންގެންދާ އަގުހުރި މަސައްކަތްތައް ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އިތުރަށް ވަރުގަދަވެގެންދާނެކަން އަޅުގަނޑަށް ޔަޤީނެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އަރުވަމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham sends Independence Day Greetings to the Secretary of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the United Mexican States, His Excellency Roberto Velasco Alvarez, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Mexico.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to the Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the United Mexican States, His Excellency Roberto Velasco Alvarez, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Mexico.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, and on my own behalf, I wish to extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the United Mexican States on the occasion of your Independence Day.

I remain assured that the friendly relations between our two countries will continue to strengthen in the future.

Let me also extend my best wishes for your good health and well-being and for the prosperity of the people of Mexico.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: ‏‎މެކްސިކޯގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: މެކްސިކޯގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލެންސީ ރޮބާޓޯ ވެލަސްކޯ އަލްވަރޭޒް އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
މެކްސިކޯގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސެލެންސީ ރޮބާޓޯ ވެލަސްކޯ އަލްވަރޭޒް އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏‎"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި، މެކްސިކޯގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި އިޚްލާސްތެރި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

‏‎މެކްސިކޯ އާއި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ އާ ދެމެދު އޮންނަ ގާތް ގުޅުމާއި، ދެޤައުމު ދެމެދުގައި އޮންނަ އެއްބާރުލުން ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިވެގެންދާނެކަމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު އުއްމީދު ކުރަމެވެ.

‏‎އަދި މި ފުރުސަތުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށް ދުޅަހެޔޮ ސިއްޙަތާއި މެކްސިކޯގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ތަނަވަސްކަން ލިބުމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު އެދެމެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އަރުވަމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

dv.title: ނިކަރާގުއާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ނިކަރާގުއާގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ވަލްޑްރެކް ލުޑްވިންގް ހައިސްޓްކެ ވައިޓެކަރ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.
dv.body:
ނިކަރާގުއާގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ވަލްޑްރެކް ލުޑްވިންގް ހައިސްޓްކެ ވައިޓެކަރ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި ނިކަރާގުއާގެ ސަރުކާރަށް އަދި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ނިކަރާގުއާގެ ދެމެދުގައި އޮތް ރަޙްމަތްތެރިކަމާއި އެއްބާރުލުމުގެ ގުޅުން ކުރިޔަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައިވެސް އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިވެ، ދެމެހެއްޓެނިވި ގޮތެއްގައި ދެމިގެންދާނެ ކަމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު ޔަޤީންކުރަމެވެ.

‏އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

dv.title: ގުއަޓެމާލާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ގުއަޓެމާލާގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ކާރލޮސް ރަމީރޯ މަރޓީނެޒް އަލްވަރަޑޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.
dv.body:
ގުއަޓެމާލާގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ ކާރލޮސް ރަމީރޯ މަރޓީނެޒް އަލްވަރަޑޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.

‏ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި، މަނިކުފާނާއި ގުއަޓެމާލާ ސަރުކާރަށާއި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް، ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި އިޚްލާޞްތެރި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާ އާއި ގުއަޓެމާލާ، ދެޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައި އޮންނަ ރަޙްމަތްތެރިކަމުގެ ގުޅުމާއި ގާތް އެއްބާއްބާރުލުން ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި އިތުރަށް ހަރުދަނާވެ، ފުޅާވެގެންދާނެ ކަމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު ޔަޤީންކުރަމެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham sends National Day greetings to El Salvador
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Juana Alexandra Hill Tinoco, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of El Salvador on the occasion of the National Day of El Salvador.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends a message of felicitations to Her Excellency Juana Alexandra Hill Tinoco, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of El Salvador on the occasion of the National Day of El Salvador.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of El Salvador, on the occasion of your National Day.

I am confident that the friendly relations between our two nations as well as our cooperation will continue to strengthen in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: އެލް ސަލްވަޑޯރގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: އެލް ސަލްވަޑޯރގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެގައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހަރ އެކްސަލެންސީ ހުއާނާ އެލެކްޒެންޑްރާ ހިލް ޓިނޯކޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
އެލް ސަލްވަޑޯރގެ ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެގައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހަރ އެކްސަލެންސީ  ހުއާނާ އެލެކްޒެންޑްރާ ހިލް ޓިނޯކޯ އަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފިއެވެ.

‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި ކަމަނައަށާއި އެލް ސަލްވަޑޯރގެ ސަރުކާރަށް އަދި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ގައުމީ ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

އެލް ސަލްވަޑޯރ އާއި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާ ދެގައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައިވާ އެއްބާރުލުން ކުރިއަށް އޮތް އަހަރުތަކުގައި ހަރުދަނާވެ، އިތުރުވެގެންދާނެކަމަށް އަޅުގަނޑު އުންމީދުކުރަމެވެ.

އަޅުގަނޑު ކަމަނާއަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް، މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Iruthisham sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Costa Rica
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship of the Republic of Costa Rica, His Excellency Manuel Tovar Rivera, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Costa Rica.
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Republic of Maldives, Her Excellency Iruthisham Adam sends Independence Day greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship of the Republic of Costa Rica, His Excellency Manuel Tovar Rivera, on the occasion of the Independence Day of Costa Rica.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Costa Rica, on the occasion of your Independence Day.

I am confident that the ties of friendship and collaboration between Maldives and Costa Rica will continue to flourish and strengthen in the future.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

ENDS

dv.title: ކޮސްޓަ ރިކާގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އެ ގައުމުގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު ފޮނުއްވައިފި
dv.description: ކޮސްޓަ ރީކާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ މަނުއެލް ޓޮވާރު ރިވޭރާއަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ. ‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ. ‏"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ…
dv.body:
ކޮސްޓަ ރީކާގެ މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ މުނާސަބަތުގައި އެޤައުމުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، ހިޒް އެކްސަލެންސީ މަނުއެލް ޓޮވާރު ރިވޭރާއަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރު، އަލްފާޟިލާ އިރުތިޝާމް އާދަމް، ތަހުނިޔާގެ މެސެޖެއް ފޮނުއްވައިފި އެވެ.
‏‎ވަޒީރުގެ މެސެޖު ތިރީގައި މިވަނީއެވެ.

‏"ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންގެ ނަމުގައި، އަދި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށާއި ކޮސްޓަ ރީކާ ސަރުކާރަށް އަދި އެންމެހާ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް މިނިވަން ދުވަހުގެ ތަހުނިޔާ އާއި ހެޔޮއެދުންތައް ފޮނުވަމެވެ.

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ކޮސްޓަ ރީކާއާ ދެމެދު އޮތް އެކުވެރިކަމުގެ ގުޅުމާއި އެއްބާރުލުން މުސްތަޤުބަލުގައި އިތުރަށް ކުރިއަރައި ވަރުގަދަވެގެންދާނެ ކަމަށް އަޅުގަނޑަށް ޔަޤީންކުރަމެވެ.

‏‎އަޅުގަނޑު މަނިކުފާނަށް ކުރާ މަތިވެރި ޤަދަރު އާކޮށް، އެކަން ޔަޤީންކޮށް އެރުވުމަށް މި ފުރުސަތުގެ ބޭނުންކުރީމެވެ."

ނިމުނީ.

en.title: President and First Lady host State Luncheon in honour of Malaysian Prime Minister
en.description: His Excellency Dr Mohamed Muizzu, the President of the Republic of Maldives, and First Lady Sajidha Mohamed hosted a State Luncheon in honour of The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, during his State Visit to the country.
en.body:
His Excellency Dr Mohamed Muizzu, the President of the Republic of Maldives, and First Lady Sajidha Mohamed hosted a State Luncheon in honour of The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, during his State Visit to the country.

Both leaders addressed the gathering, highlighting the enduring partnership between the two nations and looking forward to an even more ambitious future.

Reflecting on these ties, President Dr Muizzu noted that bilateral friendship goes beyond diplomatic dates, built over generations through shared education, human connections, and the many Maldivians who have called Malaysia a second home.

In this regard, the President expressed sincere appreciation for Malaysia's support in incorporating the Maldives into the Graduate Pass Scheme, broadening access to higher education scholarships, and facilitating visas, particularly for families with children who have special needs.

Outlining areas for expanded collaboration to shape the decades ahead, the President underscored the vast potential in technology and Artificial Intelligence (AI), digital transformation, cybersecurity, health and human development, tourism, trade and investment, and the enormous potential of the blue economy.

He also expressed gratitude for the decision of the Government of Malaysia to extend a currency swap facility of USD 100 million through the central banks, and welcomed the Malaysian government's agreement in principle to commence negotiations on a Preferential Trade Agreement.

Additionally, the President welcomed collaboration with Petronas for potential exploration of minerals and naturally resources of the Maldives. He acknowledged the consideration of land allocation for the Chancery of High Commission of the Maldives in Putrajaya on a reciprocity basis.

Delivering his remarks, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim expressed with utmost sincerity that Malaysia views the Maldives as a nation steadfast in its principles and values, with a passionate commitment to defending what is right. He affirmed his full trust in President Dr Muizzu’s leadership, dedication, and vision to transform a country with such immense potential.

Referring to the currency swap, the Prime Minister noted the importance of the partnership with the Maldives.

The luncheon was attended by senior dignitaries of the visiting delegation, senior officials from the Government of the Maldives and other State Dignitaries and the Diplomatic Corps.

Source: https://presidency.gov.mv/Press/Article/37354

en.title: President and Malaysian Prime Minister deliver press statements
en.description: His Excellency Dr Mohamed Muizzu, the President of the Republic of Maldives, and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, delivered press statements today at the President's Office as part of the Prime Minister's State Visit.
en.body:
His Excellency Dr Mohamed Muizzu, the President of the Republic of Maldives, and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, delivered press statements today at the President's Office as part of the Prime Minister's State Visit.

President Dr Muizzu described the visit as a strong reaffirmation of the enduring 58-year partnership between the two brotherly nations, noting that it reciprocated the successful engagements from his official visit to Malaysia in April 2025.

He highlighted that both leaders reviewed existing frameworks, agreed to maintain regular consultations through multilateral platforms, such as the United Nations (UN), the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), and the Commonwealth, and witnessed the exchange of new cooperation agreements in Defence and Islamic Affairs.

Addressing economic and financial ties, the President expressed appreciation for Malaysia’s continued support through the Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) and scholarships.

Building on these developmental ties, the President noted plans to enhance visa facilitation, foster joint research, and improve consular support for Maldivian citizens. Additionally, the leaders agreed to initiate negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement and invited Malaysian investment in renewable energy, digital infrastructure, construction, and Islamic finance, alongside expanding cooperation in tourism and the Halal industry.

On regional and international matters, the President reaffirmed solidarity with Palestine, welcomed cooperation through regional and international platforms, and emphasised a shared resolve heading toward COP31 to secure climate finance and protect the 1.5°C threshold for Small Island Developing States (SIDS).

In his press statement, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim echoed these sentiments, expressing gratitude for the hospitality extended and emphasising a shared commitment to deepening bilateral cooperation for mutual benefit. He commended the leadership and wisdom of President Dr Muizzu and the principled stand taken by the Maldives Government. The Prime Minister also announced decision of the government of Malaysia to extend a currency swap facility of USD 100 million and to include the Maldives in the Graduate Pass Scheme of Malaysia.

Source: https://presidency.gov.mv/Press/Article/37355

en.title: President witnesses exchange of key MoUs between the Maldives and Malaysia
en.description: His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, today witnessed the exchange of key Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) between the Maldives and Malaysia, aimed at strengthening cooperation in the areas of mutual interest.
en.body:
His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, today witnessed the exchange of key Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) between the Maldives and Malaysia, aimed at strengthening cooperation in the areas of mutual interest.

A Memorandum of Understanding was exchanged between the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry of Malaysia in the field of defence. The agreement provides a framework for strengthening bilateral cooperation and engagement between the two countries in defence-related matters.

Furthermore a Memorandum of Understanding was exchanged between the Ministry of Islamic Affairs of Maldives and the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry of Malaysia on cooperation in the field of Islamic affairs. The agreement will further facilitate cooperation and engagement between the two countries in matters related to Islamic affairs.

The exchange ceremony was held at the President’s Office as part of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ongoing State Visit to the Maldives. The visit reflects the longstanding and close relations between the Maldives and Malaysia and provides an opportunity to further strengthen bilateral cooperation across areas of mutual interest.

Source: https://presidency.gov.mv/Press/Article/37352

en.title: The Maldives and Malaysia hold official talks
en.description: His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, held official talks today as part of the Prime Minister’s State Visit to the Maldives.
en.body:
His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu and The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, the Prime Minister of Malaysia, held official talks today as part of the Prime Minister’s State Visit to the Maldives.

The discussions, led by President Dr Muizzu and Prime Minister Anwar, took place this morning at the President’s Office.

During the talks, President Dr Muizzu expressed his appreciation for Malaysia’s longstanding contributions to the national development of the Maldives. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim expressed his pleasure at being in the Maldives and commended the leadership of President Dr Muizzu.

The two leaders reviewed the existing bilateral ties and explored avenues to broaden cooperation across key sectors, including Islamic affairs, defence, trade and investment, healthcare, and tourism. They also discussed ways to explore cooperation in natural resources and address the challenges faced by Maldivians residing in Malaysia.

The Malaysian Prime Minister agreed in principle to commence negotiations on Preferential Trade Agreement.

The talks concluded with both leaders reaffirming their commitment to deepening collaboration on shared international priorities, including the Palestinian cause, as well as strengthening coordination at the United Nations and other multilateral fora.

The Maldives and Malaysia have maintained 58 years of close diplomatic relations, characterised by frequent high-level exchanges, robust people-to-people connections, and enduring development partnerships.

Source: https://presidency.gov.mv/Press/Article/37353

en.title: Prime Minister of Malaysia accorded ceremonial welcome to the Maldives
en.description: The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, was accorded a ceremonial welcome to the Maldives on Tuesday morning.
en.body:
The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, was accorded a ceremonial welcome to the Maldives on Tuesday morning.

The ceremony commenced at the Republic Square, where His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu formally received Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim. Students of Dharumavantha School presented a cultural performance, followed by a 21-gun salute by Maldives National Defence Force (MNDF).

The national anthems of Malaysia and the Maldives were played, followed by a Guard of Honour, and the presentation of host and visiting delegation dignitaries.

Source: https://presidency.gov.mv/Press/Article/37350

en.title: Prime Minister of Malaysia arrives in the Maldives on a State Visit
en.description: The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, has arrived in the Maldives on a State Visit at the invitation of His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu.
en.body:
The Honourable Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, has arrived in the Maldives on a State Visit at the invitation of His Excellency President Dr Mohamed Muizzu.
